decisions.reason: After another year without visible reinforcement, this healthcare and hospitality recruitment service remains far from our maritime aspirations, so boundedly rational management would likely redeploy resources to better-fitting activities.

The superyacht crew recruitment service still fits our crewing capabilities, customer relationships and maritime labour network, so available slack supports continued retention while we learn its longer-run performance.
The maritime education programme shows early partner uptake and builds directly on our training centres and maritime know-how, making it likely to stay above or near aspiration as it scales.

The emissions monitoring and compliance service has already demonstrated successful delivery against a hard regulatory deadline, so it clearly supports aspirations and strengthens our core integrated offer.

The emissions compliance dashboard is closely tied to our ship management software and clients’ compliance needs, so even with limited outcome data we would keep it as a strategically coherent digital extension.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is a somewhat more experimental but still complementary add-on to our compliance services, and current organisational slack makes continued market testing preferable to withdrawal.
